exposure: diagnosis of caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy
different treatment modalities (conservative, surgical, ultrasound-guided intrasac methotrexate injection)
cohort: The study included 47 pregnant women diagnosed with caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy.
finding: Early diagnosis and conservative management, particularly with ultrasound-guided intrasac methotrexate injection, are crucial to prevent morbidities in caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy cases.
